workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've read Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are their overlapping free slots for a 30-min meeting:

Monday: 09:00-09:30 or 09:30-10:00
Tuesday: 11:00-11:30 or 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00
Wednesday: 12:00-12:30 or 13:30-14:00 or 14:00-14:30 or 15:00-15:30
Thursday: 09:00-09:30 or 10:00-10:30 or 12:00-12:30 or 13:00-13:30 or 14:30-15:00
Friday: 09:00-09:30 or 11:00-12:00 (either 11:00-11:30 or 11:30-12:00) or 13:30-14:00

Please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them. Preferably start with a couple of options so we can book quickly!
